title: The Return from Exile to Jerusalem
description: An overview of the first to return from captivity in Babylon to Jerusalem and Judah under the leadership of Zerubbabel and Joshua. The text provides a detailed census of the tribes of Israel, priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, temple servants, and descendants of Solomon's servants. It also mentions those who could not prove their lineage and were therefore excluded from priestly service, as well as the voluntary gifts from family heads for the rebuilding of God's house.
